notes.title: openCanvas 7.0.07 Released - December 13th, 2017
notes.content:
[h1]■Failure Correction[/h1]
[list]
[*]Layer mode preview display error has been corrected.
[/list]

[h1]■Function Addtion[/h1]
[list]
[*]Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese languages are now supported.
[/list]

[h1]■Note[/h1]
[olist]
Brush list language can be changed by following below steps: 
[*]Click the menu button (≡) at top-right in the brush list window.
[*]Click [Revert to Initial Setting] in the popped up window.
  Jananese: [初期設定に戻す]
  Simplified Chinese: [还原到初始设置]
  Traditional Chinese: [恢復到＆初始設置]
[*]Click [Yes] to switch from the current language setting to the default brush file in the newly selected language. 
[/olist]
[olist]
Please note that modified brush setting and added brushes will be removed.
If you want to keep those brushes, please follow the below steps in order to transfer:
[*]Click the brush or folder that you want to keep.
[*]Click the menu button (≡) at top-right in the brush window.
[*]Click [Save Brush] in the popped up window.
  Jananese: [ブラシを保存]
  Simplified Chinese: [保存笔刷]
  Traditional Chinese: [存檔筆刷]
[*]After switching the brush list, go to menu and click [Append Brush List] in order to add the previously saved brush files.
  Jananese: [ブラシを追加]
  Simplified Chinese: [追加笔刷]
  Traditional Chinese: [追加筆刷集]
[/olist]

notes.title: Notice of openCanvas7.0.05 RC version Release
notes.content:
[h1]In order to improve the display speed, we implemented the major updates.
As a result, this effort increased approximately 5 to 10 time faster speed!

Because this was the major updates, we would like you to test the Release Candidate version prior to the official release.
Once we confirm there is no major bug with the RC version, we are going to announce the official release.
Please try and give us feedback![/h1]

■ Contents of updates: 
- Performance decrease with large numbers of layer has been improved.
- Layer image display error while performing Free Transform has been fixed.
- Hand Control display error at switching a canvas by clicking a tab has been fixed.
- Overlapping User Interface text with an icon image has been fixed.

■ How to install the RC version
1. Start Steam Client
2. Go to [LIBRARY] tab and click [SOFTWARE] in the popped up menu.
3. Right-click [openCanvas 7] and go to [Properties] in the popped up menu.
4. In the dialog box, click [BETAS] tab on the right side.
5. In "Select the beta you would like to opt into:", select [release candidate].
6. Update will automatically start. Start openCanvas7 once the update is completed.

■ Bug Report
If you find a bug, please send us the below information to our support group: support@portalgraphics.net
- openCanvas version: 7.0.05 RC
- Operating System: example) Windows10, 64bit
- CPU: example) Intel Corei5 2.4 GHz
- RAM: example) 4 GB
- Pen Tablet: example) Wacom Intuos Draw small
- Error Detail: example) An error occurred at creating a canvas.
- Steps to reproduce an error: example) 1. Show a new dialog. / 2. set as 1980x1080px / 3. An error occurred at clicking OK button.
- Screen Shot Image: example) A screen shot of when an error message appeared.

Best Regards,
